tasks.goal: Patrol the perimeter of the Balto Statue outcrop on Pilgrim Hill, capturing images of the bronze statue and surrounding bedrock for charter exhibit digitization.
tasks.terrain: Central Park bedrock outcrop with exposed granite, tree roots, ice in winter, and crowds of visitors around the statue
success: Maintain >=1.0 m clearance from statue plinth
safety_stops: E-stop if human within 1.5 m of path
Stop on pitch/roll > 20 deg on bedrock
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward approves the patrol route file and confirms captured imagery is suitable before it enters the Charter Hall exhibit.

tasks.goal: Walk to the edge of the pond near Balto's hill and collect near-shore water surface readings to support park-environment synthesis research.
tasks.terrain: Grass slope down to pond edge, muddy shoreline, goose droppings, and occasional boardwalk edges
success: No slip events requiring recovery > 2 per run
safety_stops: E-stop on human or dog within 2 m
tasks.human_in_loop: A human researcher approves shoreline sample points and signs off on sensor calibration before data enters the evidence base.

tasks.goal: Arrange printed proposal packets and microphones on the forum table for a human deliberation session about pending DAO proposals.
tasks.terrain: Fixed indoor installation; tabletop with paper packets, cups, and cables as collision hazards
success: Place 8 packets within 2 cm of target poses
safety_stops: Stop when human hand enters workspace
Stop on unexpected object in gripper
tasks.human_in_loop: A person verifies packet order matches the agenda and gives the final go-ahead before deliberation begins; robot never enacts proposals.

tasks.goal: Greet visitors at Charter Hall and hand-deliver printed charter summaries while reciting the contribution model.
tasks.terrain: Flat marble floor with visitor queues, stanchions, and wheelchair users
success: Speech recognition accuracy >= 90% on scripted lines
safety_stops: Stop on tip detection from IMU
tasks.human_in_loop: A docent approves the greeting script and can pause the robot at any time; charter text changes require human vote.

tasks.goal: Fly a low-altitude scan over the Progress Observatory zone to generate a live occupancy map of visitor flow for progress dashboarding.
tasks.terrain: Indoor high-ceiling hall with hanging banners, balcony railings, and light rigs as aerial obstacles
safety_stops: Kill motors on attitude error > 30 deg
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward approves the flight volume and manually verifies no visitors are beneath the flight path before launch.

tasks.goal: Inspect cable trays and router racks under the Operations Deck floor for the Task Router agent, flagging thermal and connectivity anomalies.
tasks.terrain: Raised-floor crawl space with cable bundles, support pillars, and 60 cm clearance limits
safety_stops: Stop on unexpected human in crawl space
Stop on thermal reading > 70 C nearby
tasks.human_in_loop: A human technician confirms flagged anomalies and authorizes any physical intervention; agents only report, never enact fixes.

tasks.goal: Run a repeatable 7-DoF joint calibration trajectory on the lab bench so synthesizer readings from mounted instruments stay consistent across sessions.
tasks.terrain: Benchtop with microscope mounts, sample trays, and glassware within the arm workspace
success: Repeat 20 trajectories with joint repeatability <= 0.1 mm
safety_stops: Stop on human within workspace envelope
tasks.human_in_loop: A lab supervisor approves the calibration trajectory file and validates results before instruments are declared calibration-valid.
